findings.class: STORE EMITS, TRACKER DROPS — plan invalidation gap
findings.claim: LightingStore.add/update/remove dual-emit `elementType: 'lighting'` on storeEventBus specifically so the ten derived consumers can see it, and ViewDependencyTracker._onStoreEvent discards every one of them on its first line because 'lighting' is not in GEOMETRY_ELEMENT_TYPES. The store's own header names this as DECLARED-NOT-FIXED. User-visible: placing, moving or deleting a fixture dirties no plan view, so the plan pane does not re-project for it; and because lighting contributes zero projected LineSegments, no sheet/PDF export carries a fixture at all. `room` has the identical defect (see rooms.json B4-ROOM-01) — two families, one line.
findings.contract_clause: C11 §6.2 (plan-view update mechanism); C11 §11.2 checklist item 5
